title: Small World Machine Savegame Descriptor
description: Schema for savegame descriptors (ADR 0041 Stufe 5, format v1). A savegame extends the level-descriptor context (ADR 0020): it stores runtime state referencing concrete levels/instances by stable ids — patch actions and minimal state flags, never copies of content objects. Validated by SavegameValidation.test.ts.

id.description: Stable savegame id in namespace:path form (ADR 0041 §2), e.g. 'the-whisper:slot-01'. Never reused.

app.description: App namespace this savegame belongs to (the app's stable id from app.json, ADR 0041 §2).

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the savegame format (ADR 0041 §4). Unknown or future values fail fast on load.

storage.description: Format-level storage hint (ADR 0041 §1): IndexedDB/OPFS are the standard, file export is optional; never localStorage for everything.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the savegame's creation.

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the savegame's last update.

settings.description: User settings. Language is a setting, not content (ADR 0041 §1/§3). Unknown setting keys are tolerated so newer engines may add preferences without breaking older loaders (forward tolerance, ADR 0041 §4).

language.description: UI/dialogue language (e.g. 'de', 'en'). A setting, not game content.

levels.description: Runtime state per referenced level/instance (ADR 0041 §1): stable ids plus minimal state flags and patch actions.

id.description: Stable level/instance id as declared in the app manifest (ADR 0041 §2).

flags.description: Minimal state flags restricted to JSON primitives — never content objects (ADR 0041 §1).

patches.description: Instance-branch overrides (Roblox-/Content-Patcher pattern, ADR 0041 §6) — never whole-object replacements.

patchAction.description: One override referencing an ID. Unknown fields are permitted and preserved (forward tolerance, ADR 0041 §4).

op.description: Action verb applied at the instance branch.

target.description: A declared level/instance id from 'levels[]' or a stable namespace:path id (e.g. 'flakturm/bunker_blast_door'). Enforced testably by assertSavegameIdReferences (ADR 0041 §15.5).

path.description: Dotted path of the state slot inside the target (e.g. 'door.blasted').

value.description: Payload of a set/add action. Any JSON value; may be omitted.
